title: Pause/resume parse validation checks arity+alternation but not at_ms ordering; inverted times silently drop the pause and u64-underflow ticks_stepped_by
detail: `at 70000ms pause` + `at 60500ms resume` passes arity+alternation, but paused_at (run.odin:110-117, last event in array order wins) never pauses, and ticks_stepped_by's `hi - pe + 1` wraps u64 when re < pe — silently wrong apply_ticks, exactly the fail-loud gap the hardening targeted.
recommended_fix: In parse_demo's pause/resume cases, reject an event whose at_ms is <= the previous pause event's at_ms (track last_pause_ms alongside last_pause), mirroring the existing alternation check.
